records.name: Nepali Student Association at Penn (PennNSA)
records.summary: A Penn student group for Nepali students and anyone curious about Nepali culture. It works to build community, and it hosts talks on public life and the economy in Nepal.
records.what_you_do: Come to cultural and social events and join discussions about Nepal. You can also meet other students with ties to the country.

first_step.how: Email the club to ask how to join and get on its list for events
first_step.basis: The directory invites students to email the club and lists no application step

records.notes: Directory entry only: no website and no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with approved set to true. The application field is an unlabeled code, so the entry's invitation to email is used.

records.name: Netter Center Student Advisory Board
records.summary: A board of Penn students who advise the Netter Center, a university center that works with West Philadelphia on community problems.
records.what_you_do: Board members help the center connect with Penn groups and departments, and they weigh in on its programs.

first_step.how: Membership is by staff selection, not an open application. Students usually come to the board after taking a Penn community service course (called ABCS) or joining a Netter service program.
first_step.basis: The directory says the board is not accepting members, and staff choose its members

records.notes: Appointed board, so open_to is invite and friendliness is 1. If the owner prefers to hide appointed boards, change to hide with hidden_reason private. The board page lists rosters for the academic years 2025 to 2026 and earlier, with no month shown, so no last_sign_of_life is set. The directory email is the general Netter Center address.

records.name: Neuroscience Society at Penn
records.summary: Penn students curious about how the brain works and how to build a career in neuroscience. The club hosts talks, workshops, and physician shadowing with Penn neurologists and neurosurgeons.
records.what_you_do: Join through the club's listserv, then come to general meetings and speaker events. You can also apply to the journal or research committee.

first_step.how: Sign up for the club's listserv through the link on its directory entry, then come to a general meeting or speaker event
first_step.basis: The club says new members start with the listserv, and its meetings and speaker events are open to students

records.notes: Directory entry only: no website and no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with approved set to true. The application field is an unlabeled code (1), so the listserv route from the entry text is used.

records.name: Nursing and Healthcare Management
records.summary: A small student board in Penn's Nursing and Healthcare Management program. It passes student views to Penn Nursing's leaders and plans speaker events and community projects.
records.what_you_do: Board members link Penn Nursing's administration with NHCM students. They also help plan speaker events and community-building work.

first_step.how: The directory says the board is not taking new members. Students in the program can ask Penn Nursing how the board chooses its members.
first_step.basis: The directory says the board is not accepting members, and it has only 8 members

records.notes: Directory entry only. The NHCM program page does not mention the student board. Directory status reads PRELIMINARY with active and approved set to true, and the entry shows a founding date in late 2025 that is not used as activity evidence.

records.name: Nursing Students for Global Health (NSGH)
records.summary: Penn nursing students who focus on global health. They do community service in Philadelphia and internationally, and they host education and networking events.
records.what_you_do: Come to events, volunteer on service projects, or join a committee by emailing the board.

first_step.how: Email the board to join, or come to one of the events. The directory says membership and events are open.
first_step.basis: The directory says membership and events are open to everyone, and the board takes requests by email

records.notes: The club site has no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with active and approved set to true. The application field is an unlabeled code (1). The entry says everyone may join, but recorded as students because it does not say people outside Penn may join.

records.name: Nutrition and Advocacy Partners at Penn
records.summary: A student group in Penn's nursing school that applies nutrition science to health care and everyday wellness. It runs workshops, volunteer work, and peer learning on food and health.
records.what_you_do: Take part in nutrition workshops, hands-on learning, and volunteer projects with other students.

first_step.how: The directory does not say how to join. Message the club by email or on Instagram to ask about its next meeting and whether an application is needed.
first_step.basis: The directory says the club accepts members, but it does not explain how to join or whether an application is required, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: Directory entry only: no website and no dated events. Directory status reads Preliminary with approved and active set to true. The entry's founding date (January 15, 2026) does not match its created date (September 17, 2020), so neither is used as activity evidence.

records.name: Off The Beat
records.summary: A Penn a cappella group that sings mostly modern rock and pop, with some R&B, electronic, and funk. It is an all-gender group of students.
records.what_you_do: Sing with the group and perform. Interested students can check the auditions page on the group's website and follow its social pages for updates.

first_step.how: Check the auditions page on the group's website, and follow its social pages for updates
first_step.basis: The site links to an auditions page, but the details were not on the page we read, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: The club homepage shows no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with approved set to true. The application field is an unlabeled code (3). The advisor's name and address on the directory were not recorded. The booking address on the site was not used.

records.name: Outdoors Club at Penn
records.summary: A student club for hikers, climbers, bikers, and anyone else who loves the outdoors. It plans trips, builds outdoor skills, and meets weekly to talk over past trips and plan new ones.
records.what_you_do: Come to the weekly general meeting, join a trip the club is planning, or join its group chat for spur of the moment outings.

schedule.text: General meetings on Wednesdays at 9 pm, plus trips planned in the club's group chat

first_step.how: Join the listserv through the club's Google form to get weekly emails, then come to a Wednesday general meeting
first_step.basis: The club says it is open to anyone in the Penn community, with a listserv sign-up and weekly meetings, and the entry describes no application

records.notes: The club site and directory list no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with active and approved set to true. The entry says open to anyone in the Penn community, recorded as students. The directory lists 445 members.

records.name: Pan-Asian Dance Troupe
records.summary: A Penn dance group that performs traditional, modern, and fusion dance from across Asia. It runs workshops during the academic year and a yearly production each February.
records.what_you_do: Learn and perform Asian fusion, traditional, and modern dance, and take part in the troupe's yearly February show.

schedule.text: Fall 2026 open auditions were listed for Sunday, August 30, 5 to 7 pm, and Monday, August 31, 9:30 to 11:30 pm

first_step.how: Attend an open audition, or fill out the interest form on the fall auditions page of the troupe's website for updates
first_step.basis: Joining starts with an open audition followed by a selective callback audition, so students need to pass an audition before they see the troupe up close

records.notes: The directory entry gives fall 2026 audition dates of August 30 and 31, 2026, which is the dated evidence. The entry marks accepting members as false. The website says the troupe holds workshops each fall and spring semester and a February production, with no years shown. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with active and approved set to true.

records.name: Paraguayans at Penn
records.summary: A group for Paraguayan undergraduate and graduate students at Penn. Members meet regularly over food and conversation, and new students are welcome to join.
records.what_you_do: Join the group's regular meetups over a meal with other Paraguayan students at Penn.

first_step.how: Message the group on Instagram to ask about joining. The directory hides the club's email address.
first_step.basis: The entry invites students to get in touch to join, and it describes no application step

records.notes: Directory entry only: no website and no dated events. The directory's only listed contact is a named officer's personal university address, which was not recorded. The community tag was not set because the heritage list has no Paraguayan entry. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with active and approved set to true.

records.name: Pediatric Childhood Cancer Coalition @Penn
records.summary: Penn students who volunteer for the childhood cancer community. The group runs service projects and advocacy to support kids and families affected by childhood cancer.
records.what_you_do: Fill out the club's interest form to take part in service projects and advocacy work.

first_step.how: Fill out the short Google form linked on the directory entry to say you are interested
first_step.basis: The directory asks interested students to fill out a short form, and it describes no screening step

records.notes: Directory entry only: no website and no dated events. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW with approved set to true. The application field is an unlabeled code (1), but the entry describes only a short interest form.
